name: Himura Takumi
source:
An extremely caring lawyer detective.
Yuki's right-hand man, and an incredibly caring person.

For some reason, he hides his lawyer's badge
in the inside pocket of his jacket.

He's an incredibly caring and reliable adult, but
apparently he used to be very rough.
[From [url=https://and-zero.com/characters/takumi]Official site[/url]]
